channel.title: Jacksonville Daily Record - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Jacksonville Daily Record (jaxdailyrecord.com)

item.title: Jacksonville University, Mayo Clinic offering new nursing program
item.description: The Direct Entry Master of Science in Nursing is for students who hold a bachelor’s degree in another field and seek to transition into a career in health care.

item.title: Darnell Smith says he will retire from Florida Blue in the summer
item.description: He is the market president for North Florida, comprising 36 counties from Palm Coast to Pensacola.

item.title: CareSpot investing in 18th Northeast Florida clinic
item.description: The urgent care center is building-out in the Ortega area of West Jacksonville.

item.title: UF Health Durbin Park issued $7.5 million build-out permit for medical office building
item.description: The project is part of a larger medical campus under construction in Saint Johns.

item.title: Ascension St. Vincent’s Southside names Cory Darling president and CEO
item.description: He is moving from the same position at Ascension St. Vincent’s St. Johns County.

item.title: Tony Jenkins to take over as Florida Blue North Florida market president
item.description: He will succeed Darnell Smith, who announced he will retire from the health care company this summer.

item.title: Seven Pines gaining Halo Precision Diagnostics
item.description: The city issued a permit Feb. 13 for the $4 million build-out in a the Onicx Group medical office building.

item.title: HCA Florida Healthcare opens ER in Shoppes at Mission Trace
item.description: The freestanding facility is the health care group’s second in St. Johns County.

item.title: Children’s caregivers announce a continued partnership in 2026
item.description: Wolfson Children’s Hospital and Nemours Children’s Health agree to expand specialty care.

item.title: Nate Marty, Brian Wolfburg given leadership roles on Museum of Science & History board
item.description: The construction CEO and credit union CEO will support MOSH’s campaign to build a new museum.
